entries.title: Planner ctx.cancelled is per-case and never cleared after a stage timeout
entries.summary: run_with_timeout sets StageContext.cancelled when a stage times out and never clears it, so later stages in the same case start with cancelled already set.

entries.title: DICOM de-id does not register original UIDs with the log scrubber
entries.summary: dicom_deid._register_value skips UI, SQ and binary VRs, so original StudyInstanceUID/SOPInstanceUID values are remapped in the file but never added to radintake.logging's PHI scrubber.

entries.title: Extract stage contract: report.v1, untrusted_text, pipelines and fallback
entries.summary: The extract stage (order 40) emits a report.v1 dict to ctx.data['report'] plus report_model and extraction meta. Instruction-like sentences are moved out of values into field.untrusted_text. vlm_first and hybrid fall back to OCR-first offline and record an extraction_fallback trace event.

entries.title: The 'models/' gitignore rule silently ignores src/radintake/models
entries.summary: The weights rule 'models/' in .gitignore matched src/radintake/models, so new package files there went untracked until a '!src/radintake/models/' negation was added.

entries.title: Document PHI stage outputs and the only phi_masked=True producer
entries.summary: The phi stage (order 30) is the only producer of payloads stamped phi_masked=True: ctx.data['phi_masked_pages'] holds one MaskedPayload per page. It also leaves phi_vault, ocr_words and pages with words in ctx.data for the extract stage.
